description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkClaimVerdict</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimAccepted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExamineToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" name="Recommendation needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExamineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOKToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToVerdict</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkClaimVerdict" name="Mark claim as OK or Not OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToVerdict</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VerdictToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimDecision" name="Claim marked OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VerdictToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OKToHandling</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOKToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimAccepted" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OKToHandling</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisteredToExamine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExamineToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToWrite" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToCheck" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToVerdict" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Task_MarkClaimVerdict"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VerdictToDecision" sourceRef="Task_MarkClaimVerdict" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OKToHandling" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOKToMerge" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
